from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u089/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    # Full-width horizontal bars encode a vertical repeating sequence.
    horizontal = any(sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= w // 2 for row in grid)
    coord = (lambda r, c: r) if horizontal else (lambda r, c: c - r)
    for period in range(1, max(h, w) + 1):
        mapping = {}
        good = True
        for r, c, v in points:
            phase = coord(r, c) % period
            if phase in mapping and mapping[phase] != v:
                good = False
                break
            mapping[phase] = v
        if good:
            break
    else:
        raise ValueError("No consistent repeating pattern found")
    if horizontal:
        return [[mapping[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    return [[mapping[(c-r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p=program_dir/'task-676f8cb8.py'; p.write_text(code)
